description: An additional image of a specimen of a mature Psephurus gladius (Chinese Paddlefish) that I've taken inside the Museum of Hydrobiological Sciences, Wuhan Institute of Hydrobiology of Chinese Academy of Sciences when I was searching files on my computer. Detailed information of the specimen is little-known as well.
